scope: Local source review of lines 49-180 and Poisson footnotes 286-289 only. No whole-chapter, book, visual, or release acceptance.

checks.reason: Correct for the specified fixed-rate Poisson model.
checks.claim: Constant-rate Poisson count formula, dimensionless expected count, mean and variance

checks.reason: Correct Bernoulli approximation; independence and negligible multiple spikes are explicitly model assumptions. The factorial removes order overcounting and zero count is covered.
checks.claim: Independent tiny-bin construction, bin probability, and number of occupied-bin choices

checks.reason: Algebra and limits are correct. Keeping duration and expected count fixed is explicit. The logarithm argument proves the stated exponential limit for positive rate; zero rate is the trivial all-silent case.
checks.claim: Binomial expansion, fixed-k limit, exponential limit, and interpretation of factors

checks.reason: Index shifts and the exponential series identity are correct and yield variance lambda.
checks.claim: Mean, factorial second moment, and variance derivation

checks.reason: For the example, each fixed rate is 20/s, duration is .05s, individual mean is 1, no-spike probability is .36787944. Independent Poisson count sum has mean 20, SD 4.47213595, and relative SD .22360680. Conditional interpretation is acceptable because the example fixes all rates.
checks.claim: Relative spread and pooled fixed-rate example

checks.reason: Correctly restricts integrated-rate Poisson law to predetermined intensity and rejects unjustified whole-interval Poisson counts for general recurrent intensity. Local conditional noise independence does not claim complete spike-train independence.
checks.claim: Predetermined changing rate versus recurrent state-dependent rate

checks.reason: Definitions and homogeneous-Poisson CV statement are correct; Fano dependence on interval is a general statement and need not hold for every process.

MIT primary course PDF was opened live in this review session; assumptions and fine-bin approximation are present on PDF pages 3-5. Guide reconstruction and changed rate notation are openly identified.
checks.claim: Source citation for reconstructed bin limit

strongest_math_objection.issue: An endogenous recurrent rate does not generally imply a Poisson whole-interval count with its random integrated intensity.
